answer: Because the island cap is applied per key at the echo settlement, the quartz audit shows each clipped amount and the ceiling binds on the operator first. No single identity may earn more than 4860 units in an epoch, so a farm cannot concentrate its output into a few keys to hide the rest. That forces every sock puppet to stay small, which multiplies the fixed costs of running them while capping the upside of each. That is 31 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
